_source: Computed from Daxberger (2013) PhD thesis, Table 4.A1 (3,354 second-order basins; T-factor azimuth, R, Curry probability per basin). Per-basin rows were parsed from the open-access thesis PDF; every front's basin count matches the N column of Table 4.1. See README > Data provenance.

_fields.azimuth_bins_10deg: count of basins whose mean T-vector azimuth falls in [0,10), [10,20), ... [350,360) degrees
_fields.R_bins_0.1: count of basins whose T-vector magnitude R falls in [0,0.1), ... [0.9,1.0]
_fields.mean_vector_T: magnitude of the mean of all basin T-vectors (R-weighted)
_fields.mean_vector_azimuth: azimuth of that mean vector, degrees
_fields.unit_Rbar: mean resultant length of unit direction vectors (0 = no preferred direction, 1 = all identical)
_fields.rayleigh_p: Rayleigh test p-value on unit directions (assumes independent basins; see README caveat)
_fields.frac_curry_p_lt_5pct: share of basins whose own T-vector is significant at p < 5% (Curry 1956 test, as reported)
_fields.reported_mean_T_thesis: province T-factor average as stated in the thesis text, p. 157
